title: Library
description: The resources behind the lessons: videos, PDFs, articles, images and audio, filed by module.

table.caption: Library resources
table.title: Resource
table.invalidLinkHint: This link does not start with http:// or https:// and cannot be opened. Edit the resource to fix it.

empty.title: The library is empty
empty.description: Add a link (video, article, online PDF) or upload a file from your computer.

error.title: The library could not be loaded
error.body: Check your connection, then try again.

form.description: A link to an online resource. For a file on your computer, use “Upload a file”.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: For example: Japanese candlesticks in 10 minutes
form.moduleHint: Optional. The resource is listed with this module.
form.lessonHint: Optional. For a resource specific to one lesson.
form.urlInvalid: The address must start with http:// or https://.

upload.hint: PDF, image, audio or text, up to 25 MB.
upload.tooLarge: “{{name}}” is larger than 25 MB. Compress it or share it as a link.
upload.badType: “{{name}}” is not an accepted format. Accepted: PDF, image, audio or text.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.body: The resource will be removed from the library. Lessons are not changed.

syllabus.title: Syllabus
syllabus.description: The reference document for the learning path. It is the basis for suggesting new lessons.
syllabus.noneHint: Add the syllabus link (PDF or web page) so the whole team works from the same document.
syllabus.importFull: To create every domain, module and lesson of the TACTIC syllabus at once ({{domains}} domains, {{modules}} modules, {{lessons}} lessons), use
syllabus.formDescription: The current syllabus will be replaced by this document.
syllabus.formUrlHint: Link to the syllabus PDF or web page.
syllabus.removeBody: “{{title}}” will no longer be the reference document. The file itself and the lessons are not touched.

generate.title: Suggest lessons from the syllabus
generate.description: Paste part of the syllabus: chapters, concepts, objectives. Robot Tact suggests lessons the corpus is still missing.
generate.textHint: Kept on this device for next time.
generate.textPlaceholder: For example: Module 3, risk management. Objectives: size a position, place a stop-loss…
generate.resultsHint: Each suggestion opens in the editor as a draft. Nothing is saved until you save it.
generate.editorOpened: Draft opened in the editor. Complete it, then save.
generate.none: No suggestions for this extract. Try a more detailed passage.
